prompt: Report the bounding box (min/max x,y) of each layer's geometry, sorted by area (largest first).

tool.name: layer-bounding-boxes
tool.description: Computes the bounding box (min/max X and Y) of each layer's geometry, using polyline and 3D-face vertices, and returns the layers sorted by bounding-box area, largest first.

layers.description: Optional list of layer names to restrict the report to. If omitted, all layers with geometry are included.

preview: Tool "layer-bounding-boxes" authored via the Agent SDK (engine_op=layer_bounding_boxes); runs zero-LLM at runtime.
